evidence.title: Ledger page
evidence.description: A page from the project ledger showing payments that do not match the announced budget.

evidence.title: Meeting photo
evidence.description: A photo of the official meeting the contractor in a restaurant.

evidence.title: Text messages
evidence.description: Messages arranging a payment before the contract was awarded.

evidence.title: Original statement
evidence.description: The full statement the quote was cut from, showing it said the opposite.

evidence.title: Bot account list
evidence.description: A list of newly made accounts that all posted the same message of support.

evidence.title: Edited video log
evidence.description: An editing log showing the viral clip was cut together from separate recordings.

evidence.title: Cash envelopes
evidence.description: Sealed envelopes of cash, each marked with a voter's name and a polling precinct.

evidence.title: Vote-for-cash receipts
evidence.description: Signed receipts showing voters were paid after they showed a photo of their ballot.

evidence.title: Poll method sheet
evidence.description: A worksheet showing the 'poll' only asked people already on the campaign's list.

evidence.title: Hiring file
evidence.description: A hiring file showing the new Chief of Staff is the Director General's nephew, hired without an interview.

evidence.title: Qualification list
evidence.description: The original ranked list of applicants, where the person hired placed last.

evidence.title: Payroll records
evidence.description: Payroll records listing relatives of the Director General paid for jobs with no duties.

evidence.title: Site inspection photo
evidence.description: A dated photo of the lot where the new school was paid for. It is an empty field with a rusty sign.

evidence.title: Invoice batch
evidence.description: Twelve invoices from one supplier for the same office chairs, each at ten times the market price.

evidence.title: Company registry card
evidence.description: The registry card of the company that won the tender. It was founded a week before the bid, by the Secretary's cousin.

evidence.title: Redacted report
evidence.description: A public spending report where every page about money is blacked out.

evidence.title: Request denial letters
evidence.description: Three requests for public records, all refused with the same one-line reason and no way to appeal.

evidence.title: Shredding log
evidence.description: A service log showing four pallets of records shredded the night before the audit.
